## Download

The TeX engine is inside every download: nothing else to install, and no
terminal.

### Windows

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.

- **`lotus-windows-amd64-installer.exe`** — the usual choice. Run it, and
  Lotus appears in the Start menu and on the desktop. Uninstall from
  **Settings → Apps**.
- **`lotus-windows-amd64-portable.zip`** — no installation and no
  administrator rights. Unzip it anywhere, keeping `lotus.exe` and the
  `engine` folder together, and run `lotus.exe`.

If Windows shows **"Windows protected your PC"**, choose **More info → Run
anyway**. That warning appears for any app without an established
code-signing reputation, and is expected for Lotus at this stage.

### macOS

- **`lotus-macos-arm64.dmg`** for Apple silicon, **`lotus-macos-amd64.dmg`**
  for Intel. Open it and drag Lotus to Applications. If macOS refuses to open
  it, right-click the app and choose **Open**.

### Linux

- **`lotus-linux-amd64.tar.gz`** — extract it and run `lotus`, keeping the
  `engine` folder beside it. Needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.0.
